value.option_title: pH-resolved capsid and glycan dynamics from molecular simulation
value.question: Can all-atom simulation at endosomal pH detect the one-residue difference that flips AAV brain entry and show galactose binding?
value.hypothesis: pH-resolved trajectories of four capsid trimers separate fate-linked signatures because the three-fold unit holds both the glycan pocket and the fate-flipping site.

compute_axis.quantity: Independent 150-ns replica trajectories whose aggregate simulation the answer needs

held_fixed: The four VP3 trimer systems (AAV9, AAV2, BR1, BR1N) plus AAV9 with terminal Gal-NAc (pose from PDB 7MTZ/7MUA)
Discrete PROPKA3 protonation states per pH condition (7.4, 5.5, 4.0), reviewing His229, His423, His629, Glu564
Replica length 150 ns, all-atom explicit solvent, same force field
Pre-registered descriptor set: spike loop 585-595 RMSF, VRI 263-269 order, pH-quartet contact occupancy, N-terminal 201-213 exposure, Gal-NAc contacts

predictions.if_lever: At 28 trajectories the pH 5.5 separation ratio exceeds 3.0; packed GPUs reach it in 56 vs 70 copy-hours, 560 sequential hours.
predictions.if_not: At 28 trajectories the ratio stays below 1.5 or sign-flips across replica halves; packing then buys only more noisy replicas, no earlier conclusion.
predictions.decision_rule: if_lever if the class-separation ratio at pH 5.5 exceeds 3.0; if_not if it stays below 1.5 or sign-flips across replica halves.
predictions.noise_rule: Independent velocity seeds; class gaps must exceed 2 pooled replica SDs and keep sign in both halves of each trajectory.
predictions.expected_why: BR1 and BR1N differ by one residue, so any capsid-intrinsic signature is small and 150-ns replicas may be too short to resolve it.

value.compute_tested_why: The plan varies the replica count (28, optional 36) and times packed, copies and sequential execution of the same 4200 ns on the 8-GPU instance.
value.scored_against: The class-separation ratio at pH 5.5 against thresholds 3.0 (lever) and 1.5 (not), with the anchors: Trp503 glycan contact in >= 80% of last-100-ns frames at pH 5.5 and 7.4, VRI RMSF dropping with glycan, averaged structures <= 1.0 A apart over the VP3 core, and a 20-ns GROMACS repeat within 10% on Gal-NAc contact occupancy.

arms.what: AAV9 VP3 trimer at pH 7.4, 5.5 and 4.0 (2 replicas each)
AAV2 VP3 trimer at pH 7.4, 5.5 and 4.0 (2 replicas each)
BR1 VP3 trimer at pH 7.4, 5.5 and 4.0 (2 replicas each)
BR1N VP3 trimer at pH 7.4, 5.5 and 4.0 (2 replicas each)
AAV9 VP3 trimer with terminal Gal-NAc (pose from PDB 7MTZ/7MUA) at pH 7.4 and 5.5 (2 replicas each)
Same 4200-ns campaign timed three ways: sequential (one replica at a time, 1 GPU), copies (one replica per A100, no MPS), packed (two replicas per GPU via CUDA MPS)

baseline.what: Minzoni 2026: pH-resolved AAV capsid MD on AAV8/AAV9 5-fold assemblies, no glycans, no fate labels
baseline.value: 3 us aggregate (500 ns x 2 serotypes x 3 pHs)

anchor.what: Published cryo-EM capsid structures differ by 0.5 A C-alpha RMSD between pH 4.0 and 7.4
anchor.tolerance: Averaged simulated structures must differ by <= 1.0 A over the VP3 core
anchor.independent_code: One 20-ns GROMACS repeat (same force field, same protonation states) must agree within 10% on Gal-NAc contact occupancy

checks: Anchor (published value): AAV9 stays galactose-bound at pH 5.5 and glycan binding orders VRI (Penzes 2021, PMC8428384); the Gal-NAc arm must keep a Trp503 contact in >= 80% of frames of the last 100 ns at pH 5.5 and 7.4, and VRI RMSF with glycan must drop vs apo.
Anchor (structure): cryo-EM C-alpha RMSD pH 4.0 vs 7.4 is 0.5 A; averaged structures must differ by <= 1.0 A over the VP3 core.
Cross-code: one 20-ns GROMACS repeat (same force field, same protonation states) must agree within 10% on Gal-NAc contact occupancy.
Equilibration: C-alpha RMSD plateau < 2 A over final 2 ns of a 5-ns NPT equilibration.
Noise: independent velocity seeds; class gaps must exceed 2 pooled replica SDs and keep sign in both halves of each trajectory.

phases.what: Pilot: 4 h on one A100, timing the ~175k-atom trimer single-process and with 2 replicas per GPU via CUDA MPS, to measure throughput and packing gain.
phases.stop_rule: The pilot phase gate stops or shrinks the campaign if throughput is below plan.

phases.what: Build the 14 systems with PROPKA3 protonation states (Gal-NAc pose from PDB 7MTZ/7MUA) and run a 5-ns NPT equilibration per system.
phases.stop_rule: C-alpha RMSD plateau < 2 A over the final 2 ns of each 5-ns NPT equilibration.

phases.what: Main campaign: 28 trajectories (14 conditions x 2 replicas x 150 ns) on one 8-GPU A100 instance, two replicas per GPU via CUDA MPS.
phases.stop_rule: The 58 h time box ends the phase; the derived estimate of the work is 56.0 wall-clock hours.

phases.what: Compute the pre-registered descriptors; apply the noise rule (class gaps > 2 pooled replica SDs, sign kept in both halves); run one 20-ns GROMACS cross-code repeat within 10% on Gal-NAc contact occupancy.
Optional top-up: 8 more replicas so the four capsids reach 4 replicas at pH 5.5 (16 h on the 8-GPU instance).

restructuring.sequential_part: Each 150 ns trajectory integrates forward step by step; all 28 replicas must finish.
restructuring.method: Independent replicas run concurrently, two per GPU via CUDA MPS interleaving steps, sixteen lanes on the 8-GPU instance.
restructuring.condition: Throughput must hold near 180 ns/day per A100 with ~1.25x MPS packing on the ~175k-atom trimer; the cheap check is the 4-hour single-GPU pilot that measures both.
restructuring.baseline_sequential: One 150-ns replica at a time on one A100; 560 wall-clock hours for the full 4200 ns.
restructuring.baseline_copies: One replica per A100 on the 8-GPU instance, no MPS; 70 wall-clock hours for the full 4200 ns.

scope_gap: The 5-fold pore descriptor of Minzoni 2026 is out of budget (it needs a VP3 pentamer arm).
Full 4-replica sampling of all 14 conditions (56 trajectories) is unaffordable; only the optional pH 5.5 top-up is priced.
150-ns replicas may be too short to resolve a one-residue (Q587N) capsid-intrinsic signature.
Separation is judged on simulation descriptors only, not on a measured BBB-fate outcome.

novelty.closest_prior: Minzoni 2026 ran pH-resolved AAV capsid MD: 500 ns x 2 serotypes x 3 pHs = 3 us aggregate, no glycans, no fate labels [minzoni_2026].
novelty.left_open: Prior work ran no glycans and no fate-labeled capsids, leaving whether simulation resolves BR1 vs BR1N and galactose binding across pH untested.

limits: Results are 150-ns descriptor proxies for one capsid pair and a glycan pocket; they cannot establish BBB transport or the 5-fold pore mechanism.
value.test_summary: Simulate VP3 trimers of AAV9, AAV2, BR1 and BR1N at pH 7.4, 5.5 and 4.0, plus AAV9 with galactose, 150 ns x 2 replicas each. Pre-registered loop, contact and exposure descriptors test whether the one-residue BR1/BR1N difference leaves a detectable signature.
